The [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Hovus Jorrick]] served as a [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]] for [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Rodas Borgin]].<ref name="AotE:HT2" />
